After substituting most candidates could simplify the contents of the bracket to the form (ln 25 – ln 9) = ln (5/3)2. Using (ln a – ln b) = ln (a/b) and ln c2 = 2ln c had to be explicitly shown as parts of the simplification process.

notes.key_messages:
• The paper sets out to test candidates’ knowledge of the rules and results of the calculus and also
their grounding in algebra, logarithmic theory, solution of pairs of simultaneous linear equations and
general manipulative skills.
• Candidates need to take care to avoid arithmetic and sign errors.
• It is important for candidates to not spend too much time on any one question.
